description: This Java class, ExtendedWikiHelper, extends SimpleWikiHelper to provide additional functionalities for processing wiki content from Wikipedia/Wiktionary. It includes methods to fetch random words from Wiktionary, format wiki text into HTML for display, and contains various internal patterns and rules for parsing and rendering wiki syntax, especially optimized for mobile screens.

classes.name: ExtendedWikiHelper
classes.description: A helper class that extends SimpleWikiHelper, adding methods to fetch random words from Wiktionary and format wiki text into HTML suitable for mobile display.

classes.name: FormatRule
classes.description: A private internal class representing a regex pattern combined with a replacement string, used for applying multiple formatting rules to wiki text.

methods.name: getRandomWord
methods.description: Fetches a random word from Wiktionary API, trying multiple times to avoid invalid words or errors.

methods.name: formatWikiText
methods.description: Converts wiki markup text into HTML with styling, by applying parsing rules, filtering sections, and formatting.
